what: GraphQLite 0.6.0 prebuilt linux-x86_64 .so, loaded via entrypoint sqlite3_graphqlite_init into a file-backed WAL database. Graph: 1,250 nodes / 10,000 edges, imported through cypher().
entrypoint: sqlite3_graphqlite_init (the filename does not encode it)
result_shape: cypher() is a SCALAR function returning a JSON string, e.g. '[{"p.name":"alice"}]' — there is no table-valued interface, so a Cypher result cannot be joined against facts_fts by the query planner.

k2.note: sqlite3_interrupt fired at 10 s and did abort it

k3.result: did not complete; stopped by the operator after several minutes

cost_attribution.note: Three independent runs. The cost is exclusively the variable-length path operator, not DISTINCT and not the property filter — the identical answer written as a fixed-length pattern is 20,000x faster.

sqlite_cte_same_question.note: For scale: the recursive CTE over ordinary tables answers the same 1-hop question over a graph 10x larger (100,000 edges) in 0.069 ms p50 — see sqlite-100k.json.
